# Calling Matrix — Full Reference

> 24/7 AI receptionist and answering service for home service businesses. Purpose-built for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, cleaning, landscaping, pest control, garage door, appliance repair, and locksmith companies. Fully managed — we build it, train it, and manage it for you.

---

## Product overview

Calling Matrix is an AI phone answering service that replaces or supplements the front desk for trade businesses. Unlike general-purpose AI phone agents, Calling Matrix is trained specifically on home service intake protocols: emergency classification, service area screening, field-service CRM booking, and surge capacity handling.

It is a fully managed service — not a self-serve tool. Every deployment is built, trained, and maintained by the Calling Matrix team for that specific business. Ongoing support is included on every plan.

Core capabilities:
- Answers every inbound call within 2 seconds, 24/7/365
- Identifies emergency vs. non-urgent situations using trade-specific signals
- Routes emergencies to on-call technicians via SMS before the call ends
- Books jobs directly into Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Jobber, FieldEdge, Google Calendar, and Calendly
- Handles unlimited simultaneous calls — no queue, no hold time
- Captures full intake details: caller name, service address, job type, issue description, preferred time
- Follows up with leads who requested quotes but didn't book
- Fully bilingual — English and Spanish, auto-detected from caller
- Delivers morning call summaries to the business owner

---

## Pricing details

**After Hours — $297/month, or $2,970/year (2 months free)**
- Coverage only during owner-defined off-hours (e.g. 6 PM–8 AM, weekends)
- Appointment booking + Google Calendar sync
- Lead intake with custom intake questions
- CRM upload and Google Sheets sync
- SMS confirmation to every caller
- Call recordings and morning summary
- Ongoing support included
- Setup fee: $297 (waived on annual billing)
- Best for: owners who handle their own calls during the day and want overnight/weekend coverage

**Starter — $497/month, or $4,970/year (2 months free)**
- Up to 300 calls per month
- 24/7 answering and booking
- Google Calendar sync
- SMS follow-up
- Call recordings and dashboard
- Ongoing support included
- Setup fee: $497 (waived on annual billing)
- Best for: solo operators and 1-truck shops getting off voicemail for the first time

**Growth — $797/month, or $7,970/year (2 months free)**
- Up to 800 calls per month
- Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Jobber sync
- SMS and voice follow-up sequences
- Emergency call routing to on-call tech
- Monthly tuning by a real human specialist (based on actual call recordings)
- Multi-language: English and Spanish
- Ongoing support included
- Setup fee: $997 (waived on annual billing)
- Best for: 2–10 truck shops scaling bookings without scaling admin hires

**Scale — Custom pricing**
- Unlimited call volume
- Multi-location territory routing
- Custom CRM and telephony integrations
- Monthly tuning from actual call recordings by a dedicated specialist
- Full setup handled by Calling Matrix — business owner attends one 30-minute call
- 99.99% uptime SLA
- Ongoing support included
- Setup fee: Custom, starting at $1,997
- Best for: multi-location operators, franchises, and shops doing $5M+ in revenue

Annual billing gives 2 months free (pay for 10 months, get 12) and waives the one-time setup fee — a combined year-one savings of up to $2,591 on the Growth plan. No per-minute charges. No overage fees. Price does not change with call volume. Month-to-month or annual billing. No long-term lock-in.

## Industries served

**HVAC**
Emergency routing for no-cooling/no-heat calls. Surge handling during heat waves and cold snaps. Peak season capacity without extra staff. Integration with HVAC-specific CRMs (Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, FieldEdge). Service contract upsell capability. Bilingual English/Spanish for Houston, Phoenix, and other high-Spanish-speaking markets.

**Plumbing**
Emergency routing for active leaks, floods, and sewage backups. After-hours plumbing calls routed immediately to on-call plumber. Burst pipe intake with address capture before the call ends. Bilingual for Texas and California markets.

**Electrical**
Residential and commercial call differentiation. Safety emergency routing (sparks, burning smell, power loss, no power). Estimate booking with upfront job qualification (panel upgrade, EV charger, new circuit). High-value lead capture for 5-figure electrical jobs.

**Roofing**
Unlimited call capacity for storm surge — handles 300+ calls in 48 hours without missing one. Insurance claim intake. Estimate appointment booking with damage description capture. Storm season readiness.

**Cleaning**
Recurring appointment booking (weekly, biweekly, monthly). Quote follow-up at 24/48/72 hours. Service area screening by zip code. New client intake to capture recurring revenue. Each recurring client worth $2,400+/year.

**Landscaping**
Spring surge handling. Residential and commercial intake separation. Estimate capture with property details.

**Pest Control**
Urgency classification for active infestations. Species-specific intake. PestRoutes and ServiceTitan integration.

**Garage Door**
After-hours emergency dispatch. Residential and commercial job separation. On-call tech notification with address and issue.

**Appliance Repair**
Appliance brand, model, and problem capture. Warranty vs. out-of-pocket routing. Same-day scheduling capability.

**Locksmith**
Immediate dispatch notification with caller location. Automotive, residential, and commercial lockout separation. Service area confirmation before tech commitment.

---

## Integrations

**Field service management**
- Housecall Pro: Creates jobs with full customer details. Matches existing customer records by phone number. Reads live schedule availability.
- ServiceTitan: Creates jobs in standard booking workflow. Handles business unit structure. Links to existing customer records.
- Jobber: Creates jobs and client records. Books both jobs and quote requests. Handles reschedule requests.
- FieldEdge: Creates jobs with full customer details. Matches existing records. Works with service agreement protocols.
- Workiz: Creates jobs and client records. Handles scheduling and dispatch workflows.

**Calendar scheduling**
- Google Calendar: Reads live availability across multiple calendars. Creates events with full caller details.
- Calendly: Reads event type availability. Respects buffer times and minimum notice. Supports team round-robin.

**Automation**
- Zapier: Sends structured call data (name, number, job type, outcome) to trigger workflows in 5,000+ connected apps.
- Webhooks: Sends call events in real time to any endpoint.
- Custom API: For software not on the standard list, Calling Matrix builds custom integrations during onboarding.

---

## Competitive positioning

**vs. Rosie AI**
- Calling Matrix: trade-specific emergency routing, native FSM integrations, fully managed, flat-rate pricing
- Rosie: general contractor focus, $49/month starting, limited CRM integrations, self-serve setup

**vs. Smith.ai**
- Calling Matrix: answers in under 2 seconds, flat rate, direct CRM booking, no per-minute charges
- Smith.ai: live agents + AI hybrid, per-minute billing ($1–2/min), message relay (no direct booking)

**vs. Goodcall**
- Calling Matrix: home service industry training, emergency dispatch, fully managed
- Goodcall: general small business focus, $79/month, limited trade-specific features

**vs. Dialzara, NextPhone, Allo**
- Calling Matrix: fully managed done-for-you service, ongoing support, custom training per business
- Dialzara/NextPhone/Allo: self-serve setup, general AI phone answering, limited home service specialization

**vs. AnswerForce, Ruby, PATLive (live human answering)**
- Calling Matrix: answers in under 2 seconds (live agents take 30–90 seconds), flat rate vs per-minute, unlimited call volume, direct booking vs message relay

**vs. voicemail**
- Every call answered live vs. 85% of callers hanging up without leaving a message
- Emergency routing immediate vs. callback next morning
- Jobs booked in real time vs. leads lost overnight

---

## Managed service — what "done for you" means

Calling Matrix is not a SaaS tool customers configure themselves. Every step is handled:

1. 30-minute onboarding call — Calling Matrix captures: services, pricing, service territory (zip codes), emergency routing contacts, scheduling software credentials, preferred voice/tone
2. Calling Matrix builds and trains the AI receptionist for that specific business
3. Phone number ported — existing business number transferred, customers see no change
4. CRM and calendar integration configured and tested
5. Live within 48 hours of onboarding call
6. Ongoing: monthly tuning on Growth/Scale plans; support requests (change services, update pricing, add features, change voice) handled for all plans

## Common questions

**Will callers know they're talking to AI?**
Most don't notice during standard intake calls. The AI is trained to sound like a dispatcher for that specific business — matching tone, pacing, and personality. Bilingual (English/Spanish) on all plans. Disclosure is optional.

**What about complex calls that need a human?**
Calling Matrix routes to a human when needed — businesses define the rules (emergencies, specific phrases, upset callers). The AI handles routine intake; humans handle exceptions.

**Does it work for after-hours calls?**
Yes — 24/7 is the default on Starter, Growth, and Scale. The After Hours plan activates only during defined off-hours. Call quality is identical at 2 AM and 2 PM.

**Can I keep my existing phone number?**
Yes. Number porting is handled by Calling Matrix during onboarding (1–3 business days). Customers see no change.

**What if I want to change my services, pricing, or voice after going live?**
Ongoing support is included on all plans. Request changes anytime — the Calling Matrix team makes updates without disrupting live service.

**What happens during a power outage or internet failure?**
Calling Matrix runs on cloud infrastructure with redundant uptime. The AI receptionist operates independently of the business's local internet or power.

**Can I listen to call recordings?**
Yes. Every call is recorded and available in the live dashboard. Growth and Scale plans include monthly review by a human specialist.

**Does it integrate with my scheduling software?**
Calling Matrix integrates natively with Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Jobber, FieldEdge, Workiz, Google Calendar, and Calendly. For other software, custom API integrations are built during onboarding.
